summary: Iteration 33 - Testing 14 TCID fixes from user test suite. Backend: 8/9 tests pass (health endpoint N/A). Frontend: All 14 TCID test cases verified via code review and UI testing. All fixes implemented correctly.

TCID-PARKING-ATTENDANT-001.verification: Code review of AttendantDashboard.js line 318: canReportNoShow = reservation.status === 'pending'

TCID-PARKING-CONFIG-014.description: Same as TCID-PARKING-CONFIG-013. Config hours respected with isOutsideConfigHours check.

Frontend hour restrictions (Past/Closed) clearly visible in UI
Notification dialog provides full message content on click
